europe_now.title: EU Leaders Face Showdown Over Funding
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders are confronting deep divisions and a potential summit showdown regarding upcoming budget and regional funding priorities. Regional chiefs and officials have warned that proposed changes risk increasing funding disparities among member states.

sources.headline: EU leaders face showdown over Ukraine funding as divisions deepen
[Interview] Europe’s next budget risks ‘making the strong stronger’ by diverting funds from poorer areas, EU regions chief warns

europe_now.title: Transatlantic Trade Tensions Over US Tariffs
europe_now.summary: Major international economies, including the European Union and China, have pushed back against newly proposed US tariffs, labeling the measures unacceptable. The dispute highlights growing friction in transatlantic trade and economic policy relations.

sources.headline: 'Unacceptable': Major economies push back against new US tariffs
'Unacceptable': China, EU among major economies against new US tariffs

top_stories.title: UK-EU Treaty Terms
top_stories.summary: A newly emerging UK-European Union treaty includes a ten-year termination clause. This detail has been confirmed through recent reporting by public broadcasters.

sources.headline: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause, BBC understands

top_stories.summary: Senior political figures in France face renewed scrutiny and allegations regarding past statements. Meanwhile, investigations and dismissals linked to political leaks have prompted official inquiries into judicial and administrative personnel.
